verdict.label: Prices falling
verdict.headline: Card prices are falling: hold your coins and buy only cards you will play.
verdict.detail: Ezzcoins' Top 100 index is 101.0 (+3.6% in a day) and momentum is 44: prices are falling. 84s cost 1,000, 85s 2,800 and 86s 5,400. Midweek is usually the quietest time to buy cards for the weekend.

moves.title: Sell Pedri 91 UEFA Champions League RTTK after its 17% fall, expect it lower in two days
moves.detail: Tracked call: in at 2,639,000 coins. Now 2,861,000. Sell the slide: a playable card that fell sharply in a day often keeps falling for another two days. Picked because it is down 17.4% in about a day. Two price readings about an hour apart agree on this price. This strategy is 6 of 12 so far, averaging +5.4% after tax. A sell call is a hit if the price is lower at check time.

moves.detail: Midweek is usually the cheapest time to buy cards you will play at the weekend. The next Rivals rewards come {{t:2026-11-12T07:59:00+00:00}} and add fodder supply.

moves.title: Fodder: 84s are the best value per point, 88s the dearest
moves.detail: Cheapest prices: 84s 1,000 (1.20 coins per Item Score point), 85s 2,800 (1.33 coins per Item Score point), 86s 5,400 (1.32 coins per Item Score point), 87s 7,300 (1.33 coins per Item Score point), 88s 12,000 (1.45 coins per Item Score point). For SBCs that ask for an Item Score, 84s then 86s fill it cheapest. Use fodder in SBCs rather than trading it: selling costs the 5% tax.

moves.title: Kika Nazareth and other falling cards: wait for the fall to flatten
moves.detail: Biggest falls in the last day: Kika Nazareth 83 Rare -74.4%; Ivan Perišić 86 Ultimate Scream -55.9%; Diogo Travassos 85 UEFA Conference League RTTK -48.8%; Lauren James 85 Rare -40.0%. Buy only cards you will play, and wait for two steady updates before buying.
